faq.q: What is a word of the year?
faq.a: It is a single word you choose to guide your intentions, decisions, and attention for the next twelve months, used instead of or alongside resolutions.

faq.q: What are some good word of the year ideas?
faq.a: Popular choices include peace, brave, enough, simplify, present, nourish, connect, grow, and joy. The best word is the one that reflects what you genuinely want more of.

faq.q: How is a word of the year different from a resolution?
faq.a: A resolution is a specific action you can break. A word is a direction you can always return to, which makes it more forgiving and easier to keep.

faq.q: How do I choose my word of the year?
faq.a: Reflect on the past year, make a “more of this” and a “less of that” list, find the single word that connects them, and live with a few candidates for several days before choosing.

faq.q: How do I remember my word all year?
faq.a: Put it where you will see it daily, use it as a filter for decisions, check in once a month, and share it with someone who can remind you.

faq.q: Can I change my word partway through the year?
faq.a: You can, but often it is more rewarding to let the same word evolve and reveal new meanings as the year unfolds.
